why_relevant: One of Montenegro's largest ICT integrators (70+ specialists), positioned in digital transformation and infrastructure; a plausible infrastructure supplier to banks. LinkedIn page carries project posts and partner-vendor badges (a proxy for which OEMs it resells).

why_relevant: Erste's Montenegrin annual reporting page; group-standard disclosure quality, useful benchmark for how EU-parent banks translate CBCG requirements into local disclosure.

Regional (HR-based) card-acquiring/gateway provider whose WebPay/WSPay rails and e-commerce plugins are widely used across the Western Balkans; its terms and product pages reveal the technical/compliance stack ME merchants and PSPs plug into. ME-specific presence was not confirmed in this pass.

Useful as an actor-discovery surface for Montenegrin fintech.
